name: Pop detector (scripts/motion-continuity.py)
purpose: Finds pops in any rendered film: per frame, changed pixels with no motion beside them in the previous frames. patch mode finds filled patches (colour snaps, parts appearing); edge mode also reports thin outline swaps with false positives on fast limbs. Reports evidence, never certifies.

installation.instructions: Workspace file; python3.12 (jsonschema) for schema checks.

compatibility.runtime: python with numpy and Pillow (.venv/bin/python); ffmpeg and ffprobe
compatibility.notes: Light job: decodes at 240 px wide.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.

security.notes: Reads a video, writes an optional PNG.

approval_evidence: Measured 2026-11-12 on the 2D upper-body-workout film (edge mode flags the press, curl and raise art swaps, confirmed by eye) and the 3D lab film (patch mode found a 0.2 s activation colour snap, since fixed); tests/test-rig3d.py has a synthetic pop and a smooth control.
